gloss: to pounce on; to spring at; to lunge at

definitions.gloss: to pounce on; to spring at; to lunge at
definitions.explanation: To leap suddenly at a person or animal in order to attack or seize them. The target takes に. Used of predators, of people attacking in anger, and figuratively of eager rushing at an opportunity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ネズミ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{掛|か}かった。
examples.english: The cat pounced on the mouse.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{掛|か}かってきて⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: The dog suddenly lunged at me and startled me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{掛|か}かろうとした⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧で⟦{止|と}めた→止める：00678_tomeru⟧。
examples.english: The people around desperately stopped the man as he was about to lunge at his opponent.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive. The target is marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, never ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{掛|か}かる (to pounce on the dog).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{獲物|えもの}→獲物：08638_emono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{掛|か}かる: to pounce on prey
- {飛|と}び{掛|か}かってくる: to come lunging at one
- ⟦いきなり→いきなり：09379_ikinari⟧{飛|と}び{掛|か}かる: to lunge without warning

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{襲|おそ}う→襲う：01915_osou⟧: to attack — the general word, with no implication of a leap
- ⟦{飛|と}び{込|こ}む→飛び込む：04614_tobikomu⟧: to jump in — into a place, not at a person
- {掴|つか}みかかる: to grab at someone — seizing with the hands rather than leaping
